title: 鱼眼镜头下的百变时尚少女
prompt_en: Reference the facial features of the model in [Image 1]. The model wears the outfits from reference images 2-6 and leans close to the camera, striking poses that are mischievous, cool, cute, surprised, and handsome. Each pose features a different outfit, and the scene cuts with every change. Reference the fisheye lens effect, ghosting flicker, and dazzling visual effects found in [Video 1].
